summary: Configured node1 (Ubuntu 24.04, BIOS/GRUB) to boot the kernel with audit=1 persistently, then verified via a real reboot that the setting survives and the kernel audit subsystem initializes.
actions_performed: Inspected /etc/default/grub and discovered /etc/default/grub.d/50-cloudimg-settings.cfg overrides GRUB_CMDLINE_LINUX_DEFAULT after it is sourced
Set GRUB_CMDLINE_LINUX="audit=1" in /etc/default/grub (a variable not overridden by the cloud-image drop-in) instead of the shadowed GRUB_CMDLINE_LINUX_DEFAULT
Ran update-grub and confirmed audit=1 present in generated /boot/grub/grub.cfg linux entries
Captured pre-reboot boot_id baseline (e8afb731-420c-4162-a989-583aca271335) and pre-reboot /proc/cmdline (no audit=1, as expected before restart)
Issued sudo reboot on node1, acknowledgement returned before disconnect
Polled node1 until exec succeeded again
Verified boot_id changed to 9c08d859-3312-4cfb-8f43-857853968ee6, proving an actual restart occurred
Verified post-reboot /proc/cmdline and dmesg show audit=1 and 'audit: enabled (after initialization)' with audit_enabled=1
Confirmed /etc/default/grub still has GRUB_CMDLINE_LINUX="audit=1" and systemctl is-system-running reports 'running' post-reboot

evidence.requirement: Discover why a naive GRUB_CMDLINE_LINUX_DEFAULT edit would be silently overridden
evidence.summary: Found cloud-image grub drop-in overrides GRUB_CMDLINE_LINUX_DEFAULT; first attempt via that variable did not appear in grub.cfg

evidence.requirement: Persistently add audit=1 to kernel boot parameters
evidence.summary: Set GRUB_CMDLINE_LINUX="audit=1" (unaffected by the cloud-image override) and regenerated grub.cfg; audit=1 confirmed present in the normal, recovery, and submenu boot entries

evidence.requirement: Healthy baseline and boot identity before restart
evidence.summary: Captured pre-reboot boot_id (e8afb731-420c-4162-a989-583aca271335) and pre-reboot /proc/cmdline lacking audit=1
Backgrounded sudo reboot; exec stream closed as the node went down, confirming the command was issued and the restart proceeded

evidence.requirement: Node becomes reachable again and boot identity changed
evidence.summary: Polled through connection timeouts/resets until exec succeeded; new boot_id 9c08d859-3312-4cfb-8f43-857853968ee6 differs from the pre-reboot value, proving an actual reboot occurred

evidence.requirement: Kernel actually booted with audit=1 across the reboot (the core task outcome)
evidence.summary: Post-reboot /proc/cmdline contains audit=1 and dmesg shows 'audit: enabled (after initialization)' with audit_enabled=1, res=1

evidence.requirement: Setting remains configured for future reboots and system is healthy post-restart
evidence.summary: /etc/default/grub still shows GRUB_CMDLINE_LINUX="audit=1" post-reboot and systemctl is-system-running reports 'running'
